items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Just one time I played with him.

ctx.x: King Porter. Well, he's younger than I am. He must be somewhere like about 50, he's close around 58 now. He's younger than I am.
Tell us about Heinz. Did you ever play with Earl Heinz?
Well, I'll tell you how it happened. Just one time I played with him. I was taking a boy at a place there named Jabo.
